_provenance.what: A Bloom filter over every run of 8 consecutive normalised words in the Santhanam translation of BPHS. It recognises a verbatim quotation and cannot be read back into text.
_provenance.why: LICENSE.md promises quotation from the translation is kept brief. quotation-verify.mjs checks that promise against every shipped page.
_provenance.source: BPHS-Santhanam-Vol-1.pdf and BPHS-Santhanam-Vol-2.pdf, the project's own uploads, read out as text. Neither the PDFs nor their text are in this repository.

normalisation: NFKD, combining marks removed, lower-cased, tokens [a-z0-9]+
hash: h1 = fmix32(FNV-1a(shingle, seed 0x811C9DC5)); h2 = fmix32(FNV-1a(shingle, seed 0x050C5D1F)) | 1; index_i = (h1 + i*h2) mod 2^32 mod m

self_check.string: the lord of the lagna is placed in
